shellCommands.command: cat .agents/skills/gravity-ui/SKILL.md && echo ---- && ls -la && echo ---- && cat AGENTS.md && echo ---- && find .agents -type f | head -100 && echo ---- && cat package.json 2>/dev/null; cat package-lock.json | head -40

head -80 .agents/skills/gravity-ui/references/package-routing.md && echo ---- && cat .agents/skills/gravity-ui/rules/hallucination-traps.md && echo ---- && cat index.html tsconfig.json vite.config.ts .gitignore && echo ---- && find src __agent_eval__ -type f | xargs -I{} sh -c 'echo "== {}"; cat {}' && echo ---- && ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/ && cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/package.json | grep '"version"' && ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/docs 2>/dev/null | head; ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/dist/docs 2>/dev/null | head

sed -n 20,60p .agents/skills/gravity-ui/references/package-routing.md; echo ----; grep -n -i -A3 'navigation\|app shell\|router\|theme toggle\|switch' .agents/skills/gravity-ui/references/package-routing.md | head -80

npm install @gravity-ui/navigation react-router-dom 2>&1 | tail -15; echo "exit=$?"; cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/navigation/package.json 2>/dev/null | grep -E '"version"|peerDependencies' -A6 | head -20; cat node_modules/react-router-dom/package.json 2>/dev/null | grep '"version"'

ls node_modules/@bem-react/classname/package.json 2>&1; cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/icons/package.json | grep '"version"'; ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/navigation/; ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/navigation/build/docs 2>/dev/null | head; ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/navigation/dist/docs 2>/dev/null | head; echo "--- README"; sed -n 1,120p node_modules/@gravity-ui/navigation/README.md

echo "=== icons"; ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/icons/ | grep -E '^(House|Gear|Person|Sun|Moon|Persons|Sliders|CircleInfo|LayoutHeader)\.' ; echo "=== navigation INDEX"; head -40 node_modules/@gravity-ui/navigation/build/docs/INDEX.md; echo "=== AsideHeader docs"; ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/navigation/build/docs/components/; rg -n -C 3 'menuItems|renderFooter|onItemClick|current|itemWrapper|headerDecoration|renderContent' node_modules/@gravity-ui/navigation/build/docs/components/AsideHeader/README.md | head -150

ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/navigation/build/docs/components/AsideHeader/; echo "=== AsideHeader.md"; rg -n -C 3 'menuItems|renderFooter|onItemClick|current|itemWrapper|headerDecoration|renderContent|customBackground|hideCollapseButton' node_modules/@gravity-ui/navigation/build/docs/components/AsideHeader.md | head -170; echo "=== MenuItem type"; rg -n -A 30 'export (interface|type) MenuItem\b' node_modules/@gravity-ui/navigation/build/esm/types.d.ts 2>/dev/null || grep -rn -A 30 'interface MenuItem ' node_modules/@gravity-ui/navigation/build/esm/ | head -60; echo "=== FooterItem"; rg -n -B2 -A 14 'FooterItemProps' node_modules/@gravity-ui/navigation/build/esm/components/FooterItem/FooterItem.d.ts 2>/dev/null | head -40; echo "=== uikit ThemeProvider/useTheme"; cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/theme/ThemeProvider.d.ts; cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/theme/useTheme.d.ts; ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/theme/; echo "=== Switch/Card/Flex"; sed -n 1,40p node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Switch/Switch.d.ts; sed -n 1,60p node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Card/Card.d.ts

N=node_modules/@gravity-ui/navigation/build/esm; U=node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm; echo "=== FooterItem"; find $N -name 'FooterItem*.d.ts' | head; cat $(find $N -name 'FooterItem.d.ts' | head -1); echo "=== AsideHeader props"; cat $N/components/AsideHeader/types.d.ts 2>/dev/null | head -120; echo "=== LogoProps"; cat $N/components/Logo/Logo.d.ts 2>/dev/null | head -40; echo "=== ControlProps"; rg -n -A 14 'export interface ControlProps' $U/components/types.d.ts; echo "=== Flex"; rg -n -A 40 'export interface FlexProps' $U/components/layout/Flex/Flex.d.ts | head -60; echo "=== Text variants"; rg -n 'TEXT_VARIANTS|TextVariant' $U/components/Text/types.d.ts $U/components/Text/constants.d.ts 2>/dev/null | head; cat $U/components/Text/constants.d.ts 2>/dev/null | head -40; echo "=== Label"; sed -n 1,40p $U/components/Label/Label.d.ts; echo "=== SegmentedRadioGroup"; ls $U/components/SegmentedRadioGroup/ 2>/dev/null | head -5; sed -n 1,40p $U/components/SegmentedRadioGroup/SegmentedRadioGroup.d.ts 2>/dev/null

N=node_modules/@gravity-ui/navigation/build/esm; U=node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm; echo "=== LogoProps"; rg -n -A 22 'export interface LogoProps' $N/components/types.d.ts; echo "=== ControlGroupProps"; rg -n -A 12 'export interface ControlGroupProps' $U/components/types.d.ts; echo "=== Text"; ls $U/components/Text/; rg -n 'variant|TextVariant' $U/components/Text/Text.d.ts | head -20; rg -n -A 30 'TEXT_VARIANTS' $U/components/Text/text/text.d.ts 2>/dev/null | head -50; echo "=== Box"; rg -n -A 20 'export interface BoxProps' $U/components/layout/Box/Box.d.ts | head -40; echo "=== spacing section layout.md"; rg -n -C 2 'g-spacing-|Container|maxWidth' .agents/skills/gravity-ui/references/layout.md | head -60

N=node_modules/@gravity-ui/navigation/build/esm; U=node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm; echo "=== nav index"; cat $N/index.d.ts; echo "=== FooterItem index"; cat $N/components/AsideHeader/components/FooterItem/index.d.ts 2>/dev/null; echo "=== ModalItem"; rg -n -A 14 'export interface ModalItem' $N/components/types.d.ts; echo "=== RenderContentType"; rg -n -B2 -A 6 'RenderContentType' $N/components/Content.d.ts 2>/dev/null || rg -rn 'RenderContentType =' $N | head; echo "=== Table"; sed -n 1,80p $U/components/Table/Table.d.ts | rg -n 'interface TableProps|columns|data|TableColumnConfig|getRowId|emptyMessage|width|verticalAlign|edgePadding' ; rg -n -A 30 'export interface TableColumnConfig' $U/components/Table/Table.d.ts | head -40

N=node_modules/@gravity-ui/navigation/build/esm; cat $N/components/index.d.ts; echo "=== AsideHeader index"; cat $N/components/AsideHeader/index.d.ts; echo "=== ModalItem"; rg -rn -A 14 'export interface ModalItem' $N/components/AsideHeader/types.d.ts; echo "=== Footer doc"; rg -n -C 3 'FooterItem' node_modules/@gravity-ui/navigation/build/docs/components/AsideHeader.md | head -60

N=node_modules/@gravity-ui/navigation/build/esm; rg -n -A 20 'ModalItem' $N/components/AsideHeader/components/types.d.ts | head -60; echo "=== FooterItem.js"; cat $N/components/AsideHeader/components/FooterItem/FooterItem.js | head -60

N=node_modules/@gravity-ui/navigation/build/esm; cat $N/components/AsideHeader/components/FooterItem/FooterItem.d.ts; echo "=== ItemProps"; rg -n -A 30 'export interface ItemProps' $N/components/AsideHeader/components/CompositeBar/Item/Item.d.ts | head -50

N=node_modules/@gravity-ui/navigation/build/esm; rg -n -B2 -A 12 'AsideHeaderItem' $N/components/AsideHeader/types.d.ts | sed -n 1,60p; echo "=== MenuItem rest"; sed -n 40,70p $N/components/types.d.ts
npm run build 2>&1 | tail -15; echo "exit=${PIPESTATUS[0]}"; rm -rf dist; git status --short
